subject: Myth & Symbolism
subcategory: The World Tree and Cosmic Maps
title: Uluru and the Dreaming
description: A micro-lesson that makes Uluru and the Dreaming usable.

hook.text: Uluru rises abruptly from the Australian desert—a sandstone monolith sacred to the Anangu people for millennia.

buildup.text: Uluru is a living library of the Dreaming—the creation era when ancestor spirits shaped the landscape.

discovery.text: Every crack, cave, and waterhole at Uluru tells a specific story. The rock is a three-dimensional myth.

twist.text: Tourists climbed Uluru for decades despite Aboriginal objections. In 2019, the climb was permanently closed.

climax.text: Uluru is a sacred mountain where the land itself is the text. Reading it requires cultural knowledge, not altitude.

quiz.question: What is the Dreaming in Aboriginal Australian belief?
options: The creation era when ancestor spirits shaped the land
